Commentary.Commentary: So, that is it from this one-sided affair. The hosts kick off the series with a win and this will give them much boost after their recent poor form. The second T20I will be played on Monday, 24th January at 1:30 am IST (8 pm GMT). But the build up will begin much in advance. Do join us for that. Till then, Adios and cheers!

Kieron Pollard, the victorious skipper, says that he is happy for the boys and is really happy with the young boys. Mentions that Holder knows how to bowl here as it's his ground. Tells that overall, it was a superb show from the bowlers. Says that the batters know the importance of coming in and building a partnership and hanging in the middle for a while. Tells that Pooran finished the game well because he generally starts hitting upfront. Adds that in less than 24 hours, they have to repeat the same performance. Ends by saying that tough times don't last but tough people always do and he always tries to give his 100 percent.

Eoin Morgan, the skipper of England, says that the conditions they played two-three days ago were challenging. Says they were outplayed with the condition and hopes to bounce back. Mentions that there is a little bit more bounce and they need to read the uneven bounce well. Tells that you get tested in international cricket and they just try to be positive as possible, as the conditions get better as they go ahead. Ends by saying that, they always get great support in Barbados as they have a huge amount of fans here.

Jason Holder is the Player of the Match. He says that it feels good to perform for the team. Mentions that the last series against Ireland was a disappointing one but is happy with his performance. Tells that consistency is the key for them and hopes that they keep performing the same way. Ends by saying that they have got a hectic schedule and they need to manage themselves well.
... The presentation ...

Earlier in the day, it was a dominant performance from the Windies bowlers. Holder ended with four wickets in total to earn his best bowling figures in the T20s and was well supported by other bowlers as well. Later, Brandon King's half century was enough as they chased down comfortably and the hosts go 1-0 up against England.

It was always going to be difficult when you have such a low score in front of you. England bowlers tried their best but nothing happened for them. Only Adil Rashid got a way to break the partnership but that was not enough to get them any success. In the end, it was just a day to forgot and England will look to come back stronger.

A comprehensive win for West Indies and they go 1-0 up in this 5-match series. Their bowlers did most of the job. The openers, King and Hope did well to play it nicely without anything dramatic. The pitch was showing uneven bounce and both took their time and kept the scoreboard ticking. Shai Hope fell but Pooran didn't do anything uncharacteristic and Brandon King played a mature knock which helped his team to take the lead. Everyone actually expected West Indies to go bonkers and smash boundaries to chase this down but this is the new Windes who not just show their power but play with more maturity and will show they have this swift side of them as well.
Length ball, outside off. Brandon King steers it through covers for a single. Brandon King wins it for his side. A thumping victory for them. WEST INDIES WIN BY 9 WICKETS!
A yorker, outside off. Brandon King jams it out to the off side for a single. Scores level now.
Short of a length, on middle. Nicholas Pooran pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single 50-run stand between these two comes up as well.
FIFTY! This has been a very mature knock from Brandon King. Deserves every bit of this. On a length, on middle. Pushed to long on for a single. His second fifty in T20Is.
FOUR! Lovely! All the way to the boundary in a jiffy. Length ball, outside off. Brandon King caresses it through covers. Moves to 49!
Short again, on middle. Pulled to deep mid-wicket but only for a single this time.
FOUR! Top shot! High quality batting! Short of a length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran stands up on his toes and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Change. Saqib Mahmood is back on.
Too slow, shorter and on middle. Brandon King swivel-pulls it to long leg for a couple of runs. 13 needed from 24 balls.
A rare yorker from Mills, on middle. Nicholas Pooran digs it out on the leg side for one.
On a good length, on middle. Brandon King works it to deep square leg. He crosses ends.
Short of a length, on middle. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
On a good length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran flashes but misses.
Takes the pace off and bowls a short ball, outside off. Brandon King hops and slashes it to deep point for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Pooran blocks it out. 19 needed now from the last five overs.
This is nudged to mid-wicket for one.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Full and quick, on middle. Pooran knocks it back to the bowler.
Full and on leg. Nicholas Pooran looks to flick but misses. He gets hit on the pads. Adil Rashid appeals for an lbw but that was clearly going down leg.
Short and outside off, Nicholas Pooran camps back and cuts it to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Adil Rashid into his final over.
On a length, outside off. Brandon King punches it straight to backward point. 23 needed from 36 balls.
Length ball, on middle. Clipped to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Pooran mistimes his cut and the ball drops dead onto the pitch.
Slower ball, outside off. Pooran leaves it alone.
Short of a length, on off. Dabbed to backward point for a single. Brandon King moves to 40 now.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! A length ball, outside off. King goes on his back foot and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Tymal Mills is brought back into the attack.
Slower one, length and outside off. King pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single to end the over. 29 needed in 42 balls.
Full and straight, on middle. King blocks it back to Jordan.
Outside off, tucked away to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Length and outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Good shot! Length and on middle. Pooran pulls it hard and towards long on and it races away to the fence.
Chris Jordan is back into the attack. Went for 7 in his first over.
7 off the over then! Fuller and on off. Pooran hits it down to long on for a single.
Shorter and on middle. King pulls it flat and to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Pooran chips it to long on for a single.
Short and on middle. King punches it to long on for one more.
On middle, Pooran works it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter, quicker and outside off. Pooran reverse-sweeps it to backward point. The fielder there half-stops and a couple of runs is taken.
Moeen Ali comes into the attack.
Full and on off. Pooran shuffles and knocks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air, outside off. Pooran looks to sweep but misses.
On middle, King works it to the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off. Pooran prods and hits it to short third man for a quick single.
Tossed up, on off, swept to short fine leg.
Full ball, coming with the angle, outside off. Pooran looks to drive but misses.
Tossed up, on middle. Pushed back to the bowler. 47 needed from 60 balls.
Loopy ball, on off. Brandon King presses forward to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a couple of runs.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
A quicker googly, outside off. Nicholas Pooran looks to sweep again but misses.
Off the mark straightaway! Full and outside off. Nicholas Pooran sweeps it to long leg for a brace.

DRINKS! So, England have managed to get the breakthrough but still it is a long way to go for them. They need to pull a rabbit out of the hat, in short, a miracle to stay alive in this match. 52 needed in 65 balls. Nicholas Pooran walks out to bat.

OUT! STUMPED! Quick bit of work by Sam Billings and England get their first breakthrough. Adil Rashid tosses this one up nicely, outside off, turning away. Forces Shai Hope to draw forward. He looks to push it to the off side but misses. Sam Billings quickly whips the bails off in a flash. Shai Hope had his feet out of his crease and has to walk back to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: st Sam Billings b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: How has that missed the stumps? Tossed up, outside off. Brandon King swings hard at it but misses. The ball misses the off stump by a whisker.
Short and on off, Brandon King looks to heave it away but the ball goes off the outside edge to backward point.
Floats it up, on middle and leg. Worked on the leg side for a single.
On the pads, Brandon King looks to heaves it away. He gets an inside edge to short fine leg for a single.
Flatter, on middle. Shai Hope nudges it through mid-wicket for a single. 50 up for West Indies!
Loopy ball, on leg. Brandon King sweeps it to to the fine leg region for a single.
On a length, outside off. Brandon King cuts it to sweeper cover for a run. 56 needed from 72 balls.
FOUR! Shot! Back of a length, on middle. Brandon King hangs back and pulls it to long on. Chris Jordan from mid on chases it but can't pull the ball back in play. A boundary.
Outside off, cut to point.
Fuller in length, on off. Hope clips it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Jaffa! Good-length ball, around off, nipping away. Shai Hope looks to defend but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge.
Length ball, on the pads. Brandon King flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Tymal Mills to bowl now.
Uppish but safe! Shortish, outside off. Brandon King punches it to wide of long off for a single.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Brandon King goes on the leg side and looks to push it to the off side but gets an inside edge. The ball rolls to fine leg for a brace.
Flatter ball, on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
Short and on middle, Brandon King looks to cut but misses.
Loopy ball, outside off. Shai Hope looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to short fine leg and the batters take a leg bye.
Fraction short, around off. Punched off the back foot towards covers.

SIX! SMOKED! Tossed up, right in the slot, on middle. Brandon King gets on one knee and muscles it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Fantastic shot! End of the Powerplay, West Indies are 37/0. 67 needed from 84 balls.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a run.
Almost chops it on! A googly, on off. Brandon King looks to punch it to the off side. The ball goes off the inside edge past the stumps to short fine leg for a single.
Full again, outside off. King pushes it back to the bowler.
Short and on off, pulled to mid on off the back foot.
Full and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, slower in the air and outside off. King steps way across the stumps and looks to sweep but misses it.
Shorter and on off, Hope works it to long off for a single.
On middle. Hope prods and keeps it out.
Turn and bounce! Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.
Around off. King skips down and lifts it to long off for a single.
Lots of confusion but no harm done yet again! Tossed up, on off, King works it to point. Both the batters are in the middle but a fumble by the fielder allows them to get back to the crease.
Spin from both ends then! Liam Dawson to operate now.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for a single. 78 needed in 96 balls.

FOUR LEG BYES! Races away and everything is going West Indies way! A flatter ball, outside off. King shuffles way across and looks to sweep but misses. The ball hits the flap of Brandon King's pads and the keeper gets undone as well and the ball races away to the fence.
Flatter and on off, King punches it to mid off.
Slightly short, on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
A googly, it lands on leg and hits Hope on the pads as he looks to flick it.
Tossed up, on middle, driven straight down the ground for a single.
Time for some spin! Adil Rashid is brought into the attack. He replaces Chris Jordan.
Almost chopped on! On a length, on off. Hope defends it under his eyes. The ball rolls over the stumps and to the keeper.
On middle, tucked away to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Good shot! This is full and on the pads. Hope flicks it with good timing, over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length and on middle. Defended out.
In the air but safe! Ful ball, on middle. Hope flicks it uppishly and it drops safe towards deep mid-wicket. Two.
Full ball, some inward shape, on middle. Hope defends it back to the bowler. Mahmood gets a hand to it and stops it from running away.
Length again, outside off, Hope works it to mid off for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Good fielding! A length ball, outside off. Hope slaps it to point where Roy dives to his left and stops it.
Full and on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Length and outside off, this is hit to covers.
Drop and run! Length and outside off. Hope taps it to point for a single.
FOUR! Greets Jordan with a boundary! A length ball, outside off. Hope picks the length quickly and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Chris Jordan to bowl from the other end.
Good call this time! Fuller and on off, pushed to mid off for a quick single. Decent start for West Indies.
A length ball, on off, this one comes back in sharply. King inside-edges it as he looks to push, it rolls to square leg for a single.
A short ball, outside off. King chases but misses it.
Cofusion in the middle but no harm done in the end! On a length, outside off. King punches it to mid off. Hope wanted a single but was sent back wisely. A direct hit was needed.
FOUR! West Indies and Brandon King are off the mark! On a length, straight on the pads. King tickles it fine to the fine leg fence.
A fuller delivery, outside off. King squeezes it out off the toe end of his bat, back to the bowler.
